usageNotes: Returns the top-level capabilities index for a specific node, exposing available sub-resources (such as QEMU machine types, CPU models, etc.) that the node supports. This is a discovery/enumeration call — use it to find which capability sub-categories exist before querying a specific child resource. The node must be online and reachable by the PVE API; no special privileges are required beyond being an authenticated user.

examples.summary: List capability sub-resources available on node 'pve01'

tips: The response is an array of objects with a 'name' property that maps to child API paths under /nodes/{node}/capabilities/{name} — follow those links to retrieve actual capability data.
Useful as a preflight check when building tooling that needs to conditionally support features (e.g., check if 'qemu' or 'cpu' sub-resources exist before querying machine types).
Works with API tokens (allowtoken: true) and requires no elevated permissions, making it safe to call from read-only service accounts.
